# A command-line assignment is in place before the mkfile is read, and the
# mkfile's own assignments to that variable are skipped (as in plan9port).
# So values computed while reading the mkfile see the override too.
mk -p 1 CC=clang
stdout '^prereq is build-clang$'
stdout '^CC=clang COMPILE=clang -O2 LATER=clang$'

# without an override, the mkfile's values apply as before
mk -p 1
stdout '^prereq is build-gcc$'
stdout '^CC=gcc COMPILE=gcc -O2 LATER=gcc$'

# an =U= on a skipped assignment still applies: SECRET is not exported
mk -p 1 SECRET=x env
stdout '^secret=\[\]$'

-- mkfile --
CC = gcc
COMPILE = $CC -O2
CC = gcc
LATER = $CC
SECRET=U=hidden

show:V: build-$CC
	echo CC=$CC COMPILE=$COMPILE LATER=$LATER

env:V:
	echo secret=[$$SECRET]

build-%:V:
	echo prereq is $target
